_purpose: The protocol selects the appropriate simulation domain from the SIMULATION_DOMAIN registry (Protocol Section 12). An invalid selection (e.g., membrane_fouling for a battery invention) is a CI failure. All simulation outputs must include model_inputs.
simulation_domain: <must match an entry in SIMULATION_DOMAIN registry; e.g., membrane_fouling | thermal | battery_degradation | structural_fatigue | fluid_dynamics | optical_propagation | pharmacokinetics | semiconductor_yield | network_latency | mechanical_wear | energy_efficiency | manufacturing_tolerance>
simulation_domain_justification: <why this domain was selected for this invention; must reference the engineering blueprint>

physics_model.model_name: <e.g., Hagen-Poiseuille hydraulic resistance; Newton-Raphson thermal solver; etc.>
physics_model.model_citation: <textbook or paper the model is drawn from>

failure_modes.mode: <e.g., membrane fouling, thermal runaway, battery thermal expansion, fatigue crack propagation>
failure_modes.consequence: <what happens when this failure mode is active>
failure_modes.mitigation: <design feature that prevents or mitigates this failure mode>

worst_case_boundary_conditions.description: <e.g., complete membrane occlusion; 90% state-of-charge at 60°C; 10^7 stress cycles>

sensitivity_analysis.dominant_variable: <the variable to which the output is most sensitive>
sensitivity_analysis.sensitivity_method: <e.g., finite-difference local sensitivity; Sobol global sensitivity>

safety_constraints.justification: <why this constraint was chosen; e.g., ICP > 20 mmHg is symptomatic intracranial hypertension>
safety_constraints.engineering_enforcement: <how the design enforces this constraint; e.g., pressure-relief bypass valve>

design_modification_loop.triggered_by: <which simulation result required a design modification>
design_modification_loop.modification: <what was changed in the engineering blueprint>

if_applicable.critical_failure_mode: <the failure mode that would cause patient harm>
if_applicable.fail_safe_mechanism: <how the device enters a safe state on failure; e.g., sleeve rupture → full bypass>

label: MODEL_PREDICTED | PRIMARY_SOURCE_VALIDATED
_provenance_rules: Every numeric output must trace to a model_input (Section 9.8).
Every safety classification must trace to a worst_case_boundary_condition.
Every design modification must trace to a simulation result that required it.
Every fail-safe mechanism must trace to a critical_failure_mode.
